findings.description: threadJoin(sortThread, U64_MAX) can hang the UI indefinitely if the worker thread is stuck or starved, creating a denial-of-service risk.
If sortThread != nullptr and threadIsRunning(sortThread) returns false, the code skips freeing the thread object, leaking resources. Re-assigning sortThread without freeing also leaks.

20 - ALGO_TEXT[1].length()/2 mixes signed int with size_t (unsigned). If the string is long, 20 - size_t/2 underflows to a very large unsigned value, and passing that to printf with %i (expects int) yields undefined behavior and potential memory corruption paths.
prio - 1 can underflow if prio is at the minimum allowed value for the platform, potentially creating invalid priority usage.
Direct indexing ALGO_TEXT[1] and DESCRIPTION_TEXT[0] without verifying size can cause out-of-bounds access (CWE-125 Out-of-bounds Read) if arrays are smaller than expected.
No verification that threadCreate succeeded before use.
